{{Otheruses|Ascendant}}
'''Ascendants''', also known as '''''gosho-ree''''', were those individuals among the inhabitants of [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]] who showed extreme proficiency using [[Ta-Ree]] magic. While any [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] being could harness Ta-Ree energy, Ascendants were capable of using multiple spells and had often risen to positions of power within their society, such as [[Shaman/Legends|shamans]] of [[Chief/Legends|chieftains]].<ref name="Endgame">''[[Endgame]]''</ref>
